name: reasoning-tree-reflect
description: E1 single-run Tree-of-Thoughts deliberation. tot_planner seeds the root + sizes the wave by REUSING the #443 deliberation kernel (planDeliberation), tot_expand fans out wave_width journaled drafters, tot_evaluate scores them Sure/Maybe/Impossible (critic-style 0..1), tot_search holds all BFS/DFS/beam + budget policy and loops back to expand or terminates. node_type is free text and the graph is JSONB, so this is pure wire-up — no DB migration. Edges read ONLY the flat tot_action/tot_done fields the guarded edge grammar supports.
